ci_support_linux_64_.yaml:
DOCKER_PLATFORM:
- linux/amd64
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
python_min:
- '3.11'

about.description:
stormtrack serves the India Meteorological Department (RSMC New Delhi) best-track
record and IBTrACS as tidy pandas DataFrames and CF-style xarray Datasets, reads
real-time NHC and JTWC storms and forecasts, and provides analysis, comparison and
forecast-verification tools. Optional extras add xarray output ([xarray]), cartopy
map plotting ([plot]), shapely cones ([geo]) and the workbook-parsing pipeline ([pipeline]).
about.summary: Tropical-cyclone best tracks and forecasts in Python (IMD, IBTrACS, NHC/JTWC) as pandas / xarray

name: stormtrack
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: stormtrack
  version: "0.5.0"

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/source/s/stormtrack/stormtrack-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: cb9f16f82f54ca9d76edaf8e885250392458186f976c7a13ff6966f57a1be062

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: python
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
  python:
    entry_points:
      - stormtrack = stormtrack.cli:main

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - pip
    - hatchling
    - hatch-vcs
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}
    - pandas >=1.5
    - pyarrow >=10.0

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - stormtrack
      pip_check: true
      python_version:
        - ${{ python_min }}.*
        - "*"
  - script:
      - stormtrack --help

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/atmospy/stormtrack
  summary: Tropical-cyclone best tracks and forecasts in Python (IMD, IBTrACS, NHC/JTWC) as pandas / xarray
  description: |
    stormtrack serves the India Meteorological Department (RSMC New Delhi) best-track
    record and IBTrACS as tidy pandas DataFrames and CF-style xarray Datasets, reads
    real-time NHC and JTWC storms and forecasts, and provides analysis, comparison and
    forecast-verification tools. Optional extras add xarray output ([xarray]), cartopy
    map plotting ([plot]), shapely cones ([geo]) and the workbook-parsing pipeline ([pipeline]).
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_file: LICENSE
  documentation: https://stormtrack.readthedocs.io/
  repository: https://github.com/atmospy/stormtrack

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - syedhamidali
